label: GO, final ~10 trials of episode, choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial that did not reach S2
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass) and only late in the episode: none before trial 80, 97% of mass in trials 90-99, where the value head is low (all mass in the lowest value bin). Within that span it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward 0, or the -1 penalty / missed-fixation input) and the agent must be about to choose a2 (model_act == 2, choice logit strongly toward a2). It is strongest when the previous trial reached S1 (often a rare a2->S1 transition, so rare-unrewarded leading to a stay on a2) and is mostly silent when the previous trial reached S2 unrewarded. It never fires after rewarded trials, at D1, or (essentially) at D2. Magnitude grows toward the episode end: restricting to trial >= 95 gives precision 0.91 and covers most of the top-quartile activations. The predicate uses only observed history, the episode clock, and the agent own policy output; no future variable. Dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.95. A soft trial-count boundary limits precision and recall.
